units.source_text: 源氏奉赠太政大臣的礼物，是优良的和琴一张，又添太政大臣所喜爱的高丽笛一支，还有紫檀箱一具，内装各种中国书籍及日本草书假名手本。

en.t: Genji's gifts to the Grand Minister were a fine wagon koto, a Korean flute of the kind the minister especially liked, and a red sandalwood box containing various Chinese books and Japanese cursive kana copybooks.

units.source_text: 派人追上车子，当面呈上。

en.t: He sent someone to catch up with the carriage and present them in person.

units.source_text: 源氏领受御赐马匹时，右马寮官人奏出高丽乐，声甚宏壮。

en.t: When Genji received the horses bestowed on him by the court, officials of the Right Stables performed Korean music, and the sound was grand and powerful.

units.source_text: 犒赏六卫府官人的物品，由右大将夕雾颁发。

en.t: The reward gifts for the officials of the Six Guards Offices were distributed by Yugiri, the Right Captain.

units.source_text: 源氏崇尚简略，故凡大规模设施，此次一概谢绝。

en.t: Because Genji favored simplicity, he declined all large-scale arrangements on this occasion.

units.source_text: 然而冷泉帝、皇太子、朱雀院、秋好皇后，以及其次诸人，情缘深厚，身份高贵，各方面都很体面，因此这寿宴还是办得十分光彩。

en.t: Yet Emperor Reizei, the Crown Prince, the Retired Emperor Suzaku, Empress Akikonomu, and the others close to them were all deeply connected to him, of high rank, and eminently respectable, so the birthday celebration was still held with great splendor.

units.source_text: 源氏只有夕雾一个儿子，膝下寂寥，未免美中不足。

en.t: Genji had only one son, Yugiri, so his household felt rather lonely, which was the one flaw in an otherwise perfect picture.

units.source_text: 但夕雾才华出众，声望特高，其人品无人能及。

en.t: But Yugiri was exceptionally gifted, enjoyed especially high renown, and had a character no one could equal.

units.source_text: 回思他的母亲葵夫人和秋好皇后的母亲六条妃子积下深恨重怨，互相争执计较，

en.t: Looking back, his mother Lady Aoi and Empress Akikonomu's mother, the Rokujo Consort, had stored up deep hatred and resentment and had struggled and competed with each other,

units.source_text: 但两人的后代现今都很荣贵，可见世事变化莫测也。

en.t: yet now the descendants of both women were honored and prosperous, showing how unpredictable the changes of the world can be.

units.source_text: 这一天奉呈源氏的服装等物，由本院花散里夫人监制；

en.t: The garments and other items presented to Genji that day were prepared under the supervision of Lady Hanachirusato of the main residence;

units.source_text: 犒赏品及其他事务，由三条院云居雁夫人备办。

en.t: the reward gifts and other matters were arranged by Lady Kumoinokari of the Sanjo residence.

units.source_text: 六条院内逢时逢节的盛会，即使是私家宅内的趣事，花散里夫人也从不参与，

en.t: At the Rokujo estate, Lady Hanachirusato never took part in the grand seasonal gatherings, even when they were private amusements within the household,

units.source_text: 只当作别家的事听人说说而已。

en.t: but merely listened to others speak of them as if they were affairs of another house.

units.source_text: 所以无论有何盛会，她总以为自己没有资格参加进去当重要角色。

en.t: Therefore, no matter what splendid event was held, she always thought she was not qualified to take part in it in an important role.

units.source_text: 但今天只因她与右大将有母子之缘，所以颇受重视。

en.t: But today, because she had a mother-and-son bond with the Right Captain, she was treated with considerable importance.
